item.text:
Audited all 45 Roman verses in [khushbu-e-aza.md](src/data/lyrics/khushbu-e-aza.md). Corrected wording, nasal endings, izafat, and capitalization against the Urdu. The Urdu body and stanza structure are unchanged.

Two readings merit editorial review. The Urdu reads `غیض` where the previous Roman had `ghazi`, and `لے کے خاک شفا آنے لگے` where the Roman had an extra `shifa` and ended in `aane lagi`. The revised Roman follows the supplied Urdu in both places.
